levels.surface: محمد بن عمر بن محمد بن سلم بنالبراء الجعابي
أبو محمد الحسن بن عبد الله بن محمد بن العباس الرازي التميمي

notes: «بِهذَا الإِسناد» (222) takes over the whole chain of prev8 (214), the nearest report that writes its chain; prev1 to prev7 only pass «وبإسناده» on
The back_reference is not written again, since the inherited items replace it
«أبي الحسين بن علي» appears twice in prev8 because each step has its own «حدثني»; they are two links, not one
«سيدي» is part of the name as written in prev8 and is kept in the surface; «عليه السلام» blessings are left out
The saying is the Prophet's words relayed by the last inherited link (علي); the Prophet is the end
